1932, December
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 82 Cont.
Dec. 27th Mary M. Diemer - 13 - of Windsor - pneumonia
Gustus Schneider - 48 - 26 yrs away from Church - Thanks her pray- ers were granted .... now praying for another conversion and for other son.
. . Ulcers of stomach
Joseph Diehl - 69 - heart etc. Pat Cavley - 59 - ulcers of stomach. Blank Page
Page 83
Page 84 1933
1933, January
January Michael King - 66 - cancer of throat cured - had been monthly commun- icant - promised weekly ... after two weeks ... O.K.
Mrs. Helena DeWitte - Nervous ...
Kalem Bonhana - 22 - T. B. in Kiefer Hosp. ..
Mrs. Leah 0'Brien - 30 - two children and husband - losing mind .... Mrs. M. Someroak - 40 - heart-failure, daughter soon to make relig .- profession ... hopes Mother be spared till ...
Wm. W. H. Elwood - 70 - twenty-five yrs not to church ....
Mrs. Pabst - about 35 - non C. - thought to be hopeless a year ago, came here and recovered without the operation ....
Mrs. R. Frost ... 36 - cancer of breast Mrs ... 65 ... pneumonia - crisis To-mor. Mrs. Tobin of Chicago - cancer Erma Hoff ... Terre Haute, Ind.
Page 85 Blank Page
